title: Universo Ferrari Opens in New Delhi With F80, Testarossa and Hypersail
excerpt: Ferrari's immersive exhibition makes its India debut at Yashobhoomi from October 17 to November 1, open to the public from October 19.
body:
• Universo Ferrari, the Italian marque's immersive brand exhibition, is in India for the first time, at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi from October 17 to November 1, 2026.
  • Public entry runs October 19 to November 1 after invite-only days on October 17-18; tickets are listed at an estimated Rs 2,125 per person via District.
  • On display: the F80, 849 Testarossa Spider, 12Cilindri, Purosangue, Amalfi Spider and the Luce electric car, plus Classiche heritage cars, a Racing Area and the Hypersail yacht shown in Asia for the first time.
  • This is the exhibition's fifth edition, after Italy, Australia, South Korea and Thailand — a separate showcase from the Luce EV's own India debut story.

Ferrari has brought Universo Ferrari to India for the first time. The fifth edition of the Italian carmaker's immersive exhibition opened at Yashobhoomi, the India International Convention and Expo Centre in New Delhi, running from October 17 to November 1, 2026, Autocar India reported. Invite-only guests were welcomed on October 17 and 18, and the doors open to the public from October 19.

What is on the floor

Ferrari describes Universo Ferrari as a 360-degree exhibition covering its history, road cars, motorsport legacy and future technology. The current line-up on display includes the 849 Testarossa, 12Cilindri, Purosangue and Amalfi Spider, alongside the F80 supercar and the Luce, Ferrari's first electric car. The Luce appears here as one exhibit among many; its standalone India debut was covered separately.

Two themed zones anchor the heritage side. The Classiche area is a tribute to the models that shaped the brand's legacy, while the Racing Area covers Ferrari's motorsport history, achievements and race-specification cars, according to Times Drive's visitor guide.

"An immersive 360-degree exhibition experience that lets enthusiasts and the public alike discover the passion, innovation, and relentless pursuit of excellence that define the world of the Prancing Horse."

— Ferrari, on Universo Ferrari

A boat, in Asia for the first time

The most unusual exhibit is not a car. Ferrari is displaying the Hypersail in Asia for the first time — its first sailing project, a vessel developed for an attempt at a non-stop, round-the-world sailing speed record. Its presence underlines the exhibition's brief: engineering and performance beyond the road range, not a showroom launch.

Tickets and timing for visitors

Public days run from October 19 through November 1 at Yashobhoomi in Dwarka, New Delhi. Tickets for public entry are on sale online through the District ticketing page for Universo Ferrari India, priced at an estimated Rs 2,125 per person, Times Drive reported. For diaspora enthusiasts visiting Delhi this month, that makes the exhibition a bookable day out rather than an owners-only event — but the invite-only opening weekend means general visitors should plan for October 19 or later.

Previous editions were held in Italy, Australia, South Korea and Thailand. Bringing the fifth edition to New Delhi signals how seriously Ferrari now treats India's enthusiast base and luxury market, even though none of the halo cars on the floor is being launched for sale at the show.
